abstract: The complete family of minimum skew zero forcing sets of odd prism graphs \(C_n\square K_2\) is the family of distance-two vertex pairs. There are \(4n\) such sets; their token exchange and sliding reconfiguration graphs exhibit connectedness versus frozen sliding, with a unique length-five exception.
integrity: The original-skew-rule verifier is standalone and its finite results are separately distinguished from the infinite proof. No authorship, certification or independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Odd prism lengths n>=5 only; scalar minimum had been established previously; unindexed equivalent literature is a residual priority risk. Exhaustive testing is finite and secondary to proof.
title: Minimum skew forcing sets and reconfiguration rigidity of odd prism graphs
